attack_patterns.method: the site an attack targeted is read from the bomb plant where one exists and inferred from arrival otherwise; pace, utility support, splits and fakes are inferred from movement against fixed thresholds. The demo does not record intent, so these are readings, not observations

areas.callout_note: CS2's nav format carries no place names and no public dataset ships authoritative CS2 callouts, so areas are limited to resolved bombsites. Route and callout statistics are not available.

radar.coordinate_note: x and y are fractions of the radar image, origin top-left; multiply by the rendered size

data_limits.note: single-demo sample: figures describe this match only and cannot distinguish a recurring pattern from a one-off. Bombsites are resolved, so site-level attack, defence, setup and retake figures are available; callouts are not, so route-level questions remain unanswered.

findings.subject: Juiced1
findings.title: Juiced1 (Sopra Steria NewSync) står på BombsiteA nesten hver runde
findings.detail: 11 av 12 CT-runder startet på BombsiteA, og bare 2 ulike posisjoner totalt. En utility-åpning mot dette punktet treffer hver gang.

share_at_most_common.definition: rounds set up in this callout / CT rounds observed

findings.counter: Åpne med utility mot BombsiteA hver runde. Juiced1 står der 11 av 12 ganger, så den treffer like ofte. Alternativt: gå den andre siten og regn med at han blir stående.

findings.subject: Sopra Steria NewSync
findings.title: Sopra Steria NewSync tar tilbake B ofte
findings.detail: Vant 3 av 4 runder der motstanderen fikk plantet på B.

retake_rate.definition: rounds won after conceding a plant at B / plants conceded at B

findings.counter: Ikke plant på B uten tall. De tok tilbake 3 av 4 — velg heller den andre siten, eller sett opp for post-plant-crossfire før dere planter.

findings.subject: Sopra Steria NewSync
findings.title: Sopra Steria NewSync når ikke fram til siten etter plant
findings.detail: I 1 av 4 runder med plant mot seg kom ingen CT seg inn på siten i det hele tatt. Median ankomsttid for de som kom fram: 4.8 s.

site_reached.definition: plants where a CT reached the site / plants conceded

findings.counter: Ta siten raskt og hold den. I 1 av 4 runder kom ingen CT seg inn i det hele tatt — får dere bomben ned, er runden ofte over.
